description: This file defines the CyclicReferenceStack class, which manages a stack used to track cyclic references during calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to manipulate and inspect the call stack for calculated cells.

classes.name: CyclicReferenceStack
classes.description: A class that manages a stack tracking cyclic references during spreadsheet calculations, including methods to push, pop, check, clear, and display stack entries.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of entries currently on the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last entry from the stack.

methods.name: onStack
methods.description: Checks whether a specific value exists on the stack.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the stack.

methods.name: showStack
methods.description: Returns an array of all current entries on the stack.
